correctness.rationale: In characteristics zero or p>=7 with seven distinct branch points, three degree-three basepoint-free sections [Q1:Q2:phi] are linearly independent and birationally parametrize a rational plane cubic with one node/cusp. Common zeros of W_i=Q_i'phi-Q_i phi' characterize nonimmersion away from coordinate divisors; node and cusp are the only cubic possibilities. The independent square classes Q1/phi and Q2/phi define a (Z/2)^2 cover of P1 with eight distinct simple branch points of inertia 2, yielding genus 5 by Riemann–Hurwitz and thus arithmetic-genus delta deficit 10-5=5. Pullback under [Y:Z:X]->[Y²:Z²:X²] produces the unavoidable central A1; on the torus this map is etale of degree four, yielding 4A1 or 4A2. A coordinate-axis node has two smooth transverse branches and maps to exactly two A3 tacnodes with contact order two. Delta sum=5 excludes additional singularities; Tjurina lengths 5,9,7 follow in stated characteristic. Independently computed gcd(W1,W2)=T-2, exact H(Q1,Q2,phi)=0, local tangent cubic 24s³ along the unique squared tangent and central linear form (-2,2), validating the char-zero 4A2 witness.
